subject: We have started preparing your order — M'Arte
preview: Your jewelry is taking shape in our atelier right now.
heading: Your order is being prepared
message: We are delighted to let you know that we have started preparing your order. Every M'Arte piece is crafted by hand, so your jewelry is now taking shape with care in our atelier.

nextStep.courier: As soon as your parcel is ready to leave, we will email you again with its tracking number so you can follow it easily.
nextStep.locker: As soon as your parcel is ready to leave, we will email you again with its tracking number so you can follow it all the way to the parcel locker.
nextStep.in_store: Once your order is ready, we will write to let you know when you can collect it from our atelier.

closingNote: If you have any questions about your order, simply reply to this email — we are happy to help.
